title: agent-event
description: One event from an agent adapter to the core, one JSON object per line (docs/events.md). Ids, a kind, an outcome and a timestamp only: no answer, no prompt, no tool input.

agent.description: The adapter's fixed name, a constant in that adapter's code. The core logs it and never branches on it.

session.description: The agent's session id, opaque. Separators stripped: a UUID becomes 32 hex.

outcome.description: How a turn ended. Required on turn.end, refused on every other kind.

failed.description: Whether the tool call failed. tool.end only. Information only: no state reads it since #1331, as tool.end is running either way (scripts/cockpit-event). Kept for a reader that logs or shows events.

utc.description: ISO-8601 in UTC, Z only, optional fraction.
